metadata.title: Kosh CRM
metadata.description: Salon management and financial CRM for Kosh Salon

brand.name: Kosh
brand.panelTitle: Run your salon from one place
brand.panelBody: Invoices, expenses, employee earnings, and monthly settlements, in English and Arabic.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.welcomeBody: Your salon's numbers appear here as invoices and expenses are recorded.

revenueChart.title: Monthly revenue
revenueChart.empty: Revenue appears here once invoices are recorded.

topServices.title: Top services
topServices.empty: Your most requested services appear here once invoices are recorded.

info.title: Personal information
info.description: Update your name and phone number.
info.name: Full name
info.phoneHint: Digits, spaces, and + - ( ) only. Leave empty to remove it.

details.title: Account details
details.description: Only the salon administrator can change these.

employees.title: Employees
employees.description: Everyone with an account in Kosh CRM.

fields.name: Full name
fields.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dot, underscore, or hyphen.
fields.phoneHint: Digits, spaces, and + - ( ) only. Leave empty for none.

create.title: New employee
create.description: Create an account. Give the employee the password you set here.

details.title: Account details
details.roleNote: Changing the role resets this employee's permissions to the new role's defaults.

image.title: Profile image
image.description: PNG, JPEG, or WebP, up to 1 MB.

password.title: Set password
password.description: The employee is signed out on every device and signs in with the new password.
password.success: Password set. The employee was signed out.

status.title: Account status
status.activeDescription: This account can sign in. Deactivating it signs the employee out on every device.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.invalid_input: The submitted details were not valid. Reload the page and try again.
errors.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
errors.file_too_large: The file is larger than 1 MB.
errors.file_type: The file must be a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image.
errors.storage_unavailable: Image storage is not configured. Contact the system administrator.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: Choose what this user can see and do.
permissions.adminNote: Admins always have every permission. Nothing can be changed here.
permissions.selfNote: You cannot change your own permissions.
permissions.lockedNote: You can only change permissions you hold yourself. The others are locked.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to change these permissions.
errors.invalid_input: The submitted permissions were not valid. Reload the page and try again.
errors.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

audit.title: Audit Log
audit.description: Who changed what, and when. Newest first.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Salon details and global financial settings.
settings.readOnly: You can view these settings but not change them.

information.title: Salon information
information.description: The salon's name and contact details.
information.name: Salon name

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: PNG, JPEG, or WebP, up to 1 MB.

financial.title: Financial settings
financial.description: Currency, tax rate, and the share employees earn from their paid revenue.
financial.taxRateHint: Stored for future receipts. It is not applied to invoices, revenue, or payouts.
financial.employeeSharePercentageHint: Applies to new calculations only. Existing settlements keep the percentage they were calculated with.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to change the settings.
errors.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
errors.file_too_large: The file is larger than 1 MB.
errors.file_type: The file must be a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image.
errors.storage_unavailable: Logo storage is not configured. Contact the system administrator.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.body: You do not have permission to open this page. Ask the salon administrator if you need access.

errors.generic: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Enter your username or email and password.
login.resetDone: Your password was changed. Sign in with your new password.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your username or email and we will email you a reset link.
forgot.sent: If a matching active account exists, it will receive an email with a reset link within a few minutes. The link is valid for one hour.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.description: Choose a new password for your account. You will be signed out on all devices.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.description: You will be signed out on all other devices.
changePassword.success: Your password was changed. Other devices have been signed out.

errors.inactive: This account is inactive. Contact the salon administrator.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.invalid_token: This reset link is invalid, has expired, or was already used.
errors.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
errors.username_taken: This username is already in use.
errors.email_taken: This email is already in use.

login.subject: New sign-in to Kosh CRM
login.body: Your Kosh CRM account was just signed in to.
login.notYou: If this was not you, reset your password now and tell the salon administrator.

reset.subject: Reset your Kosh CRM password
reset.body: Someone asked to reset the password for your Kosh CRM account. Use the link below to choose a new password.
reset.expiry: The link is valid for one hour and can be used once.
reset.ignore: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email; your password stays the same.
